techniques.name: Tricksplit
techniques.description: Rapid double or triple split for extended range. Press split in quick succession to project fragments further than a single split.
techniques.tips: Need approximately 2.6x target mass to split-kill. Time splits tightly for maximum range. Practice in the Practice Arena.

techniques.name: Popsplit
techniques.description: Intentional virus pop combined with split. Use a virus pop to scatter your cells, then split from scattered fragments to reach targets at extreme range.
techniques.tips: Requires a nearby virus and careful mass calculation. Risky — you may lose cells to other players during the pop phase.

techniques.name: Cannon / Self-feed
techniques.description: Rapid W ejection between own split cells to transfer mass. Feed from small fragments to a chosen cell before splitting it at a target.
techniques.tips: Works best when you have many small fragments and one large cell. Use macro feed (E) for rapid ejection.

techniques.name: Line split
techniques.description: Straight-line rapid multi-split (x8 with 3 splits, x16 with 4 splits). All fragments travel in a line toward the cursor for maximum distance coverage.
techniques.tips: Configure delay between splits (ms) and hold time. Use guide lines setting to visualize the split path. Very high risk — you are split into maximum fragments.

techniques.name: Scan trick
techniques.description: While its key is held the cell heads far out toward the cursor at the exact angle; with the left mouse button held too, the direction snaps to one of 16 (22.5 degrees each). Provides precise cell positioning for split tricks.
techniques.keys: Hold Scan Trick (set it in the Hotkeys window, hold action)
techniques.tips: Hold the left mouse button too for one of 16 fixed directions. It has no settings.

techniques.name: Virus shot
techniques.description: Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to launch it toward the cursor at another player. Costs approximately 100-110 mass total. The launched virus pops any big cell it hits.
techniques.tips: Position yourself behind the virus relative to your target. If the target is small enough, they may pass through the virus safely.

techniques.name: Bait-and-switch
techniques.description: Deception technique — appear to feed or retreat to lure an opponent into range, then quickly split to consume them.
techniques.tips: Works best against aggressive players who chase mass. Feign feeding toward them, then split when they commit.

techniques.name: Split running
techniques.description: Splitting in the same direction you are moving to gain a speed boost. The front half travels faster than normal movement, useful for chasing or escaping.
techniques.tips: Good for escaping larger cells. Each split halves your mass but gives a burst of speed. Keep splitting if pursued.

techniques.name: Virus farming
techniques.description: Intentionally popping yourself on a virus to split into many fragments, then collecting nearby food to gain mass across all fragments simultaneously.
techniques.keys: Move into virus, then collect food
techniques.tips: Only do this in safe areas with lots of food. Being split into 16 pieces makes you very vulnerable to attack.

techniques.name: Teamwork feeding
techniques.description: In Teams mode, feed mass to a teammate using W to help them grow. Coordinated feeding can quickly create a dominant player.
techniques.tips: Feed the player in the best position to attack or defend. In FFA, excessive feeding triggers the anti-teaming system.
